title: 'Avengers: Endgame' is king of N. America box office again, 'Forgotten Island' takes 5th
summary: "Avengers: Endgame" dusted competitors in the North American weekend box office, as the 2019 super hero film was re-released in a bid to drum up support for the franchise.
